emberwake.name: Emberwake
emberwake.title: The First Forge
emberwake.flavour: Warm to the touch, always. It was warm before there was anyone to touch it.

hoarking.name: Hoarking
hoarking.title: Who Stopped the River
hoarking.flavour: The ice around it never melts, and never grows.

stormcaller.name: Stormcaller
stormcaller.title: The Long Argument
stormcaller.flavour: Ferran engineers kept it in a lead box and still lost two clerks to it.

greenmother.name: Greenmother
greenmother.title: Root and Patience
greenmother.flavour: Older than the war. It did not take a side, and does not forgive that either.

ninthlantern.name: The Ninth Lantern
ninthlantern.title: Last Light of Ashenhall
ninthlantern.flavour: Eight went out. This one was carried.

hollowking.name: The Hollow King
hollowking.title: He Who Counts
hollowking.found: The Fen Barrow — past the third door
hollowking.flavour: It knows how many breaths you have left. It finds this very funny.

quarryhound.name: Quarryhound
quarryhound.title: The Debt Collector
quarryhound.flavour: Bound a thousand years ago against a debt no one alive remembers taking on.

saltwidow.name: Saltwidow
saltwidow.title: Of the Drowned Coast
saltwidow.found: The southern shore — low tide only
saltwidow.flavour: She was a lighthouse keeper. The Engine offered, and she said yes.

brasswright.name: Brasswright
brasswright.title: The Obliging Machine
brasswright.flavour: It wants to help. That is the frightening part.

lastwinter.name: Last Winter
lastwinter.title: The Quiet That Came After
lastwinter.flavour: The year the war ended, nothing grew. This is why.

vagrantstar.name: Vagrant Star
vagrantstar.title: The Long Odds
vagrantstar.flavour: Osric will not say how he got it and gets shifty when asked twice.

enginechild.name: Engine-Child
enginechild.title: The Thing In The Ninth Well
enginechild.found: The deepest chamber. You will know it.
enginechild.flavour: It is very young. It has been very young for a thousand years.

windfoundling.name: Wind-Foundling
windfoundling.title: Nobody Claimed It
windfoundling.found: Emberlyn — blew in with the caravans and stayed
windfoundling.flavour: Three parishes have written to disown it. It keeps coming back to Emberlyn.

thegleaner.name: The Gleaner
thegleaner.title: Takes the Last of It
thegleaner.found: Lowfen — in the drowned field, after the water goes down
thegleaner.flavour: Follows the harvest. Has never once been seen arriving.

theassessor.name: The Assessor
theassessor.title: Halves What It Counts
theassessor.found: Marrowgate — sealed in the older town beneath
theassessor.flavour: It does not kill things. It writes down half of what they were and the rest stops applying.

thecoldsleep.name: The Cold Sleep
thecoldsleep.title: Nothing Woke For A Year
thecoldsleep.found: Highfell — the shelf nobody cuts on
thecoldsleep.flavour: The quarrymen work around it. They will not say why and they will not stop.

thealmoner.name: The Almoner
thealmoner.title: Gives It All Away
thealmoner.found: Verrenholt — still on its shelf in the burned hall
thealmoner.flavour: Ninety-one people left in the town and it has fed all of them at least once.

thelateharvest.name: The Late Harvest
thelateharvest.title: Comes Back For Them
thelateharvest.found: Saltmarch — brought up in a net and never claimed
thelateharvest.flavour: The netsman who found it lived another forty years and would not discuss it.

theeleventhhour.name: The Eleventh Hour
theeleventhhour.title: Everything At Once
theeleventhhour.found: Stormspire — the crown, and you have to climb for it
theeleventhhour.flavour: Runs eleven minutes fast. Has run eleven minutes fast for a thousand years.

thelastlantern.name: The Last Lantern
thelastlantern.title: Still Lit
thelastlantern.found: The Last Lantern — the small room at the end
thelastlantern.flavour: Eight went out. This is the ninth, and nobody has ever admitted to lighting it.

thepitwarden.name: The Pit Warden
thepitwarden.title: Counts Them Out And In
thepitwarden.found: The Iron Quarry — the bottom terrace
thepitwarden.flavour: Every shift that went down came back up. That is the whole of its reputation.

thesaltmother.name: The Salt Mother
thesaltmother.title: Dries Everything Out
thesaltmother.found: The Saltworks — the pan that never fills
thesaltmother.flavour: The salt off her pan will not season anything. It keeps, though. It keeps forever.

thebriarking.name: The Briar King
thebriarking.title: Closes The Way Behind
thebriarking.found: Bramblewold — the far end, which is the only end
thebriarking.flavour: It is not keeping anyone out. It has never been keeping anyone out.

theundercroft.name: The Undercroft
theundercroft.title: The Floor Below The Floor
theundercroft.found: The Drowned Halls — the lower floor, at low water
theundercroft.flavour: Every building in the world has one of these. Most of them are empty.

thekingspyre.name: The King's Pyre
thekingspyre.title: Burned For Eleven Days
thekingspyre.found: Kingspyre — the middle of the room, which is the problem
thekingspyre.flavour: They could not put it out and in the end they stopped trying and built a roof over it.

thequietone.name: The Quiet One
thequietone.title: Says Nothing At All
thequietone.found: Greyharrow — in the guardhouse, in a drawer, unlabelled
thequietone.flavour: Four garrisons have inventoried it as "misc". It has outlasted all four.
